title: Effect of Flax in Yogurt on Blood Cyanide Levels
official: A Randomized, Controlled, Cross-over Trial Examining the Effect of Flaxseed on Blood Cyanide Levels in Healthy Adults
summary: A randomized, controlled, cross-over post-prandial trial in healthy human volunteers will be conducted at the IH Asper Institute to determine the effect whole ground flaxseed, roasted then ground whole flaxseed, whole intact flaxseed and flaxseed hulls mixed into yogurt on blood cyanide levels.

interventions.name: 40 g roasted then ground whole flaxseed

sites.f: I. H. Asper Clinical Research Institute
